fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Motorized Level I formations used light vehicles for rapid movement between garrison posts, providing the speed needed to respond to civil unrest or insurgent attacks faster than foot infantry could march. Their mobility made them a preferred choice for patrol duties across the Word's Protectorate holdings. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
